objects.name: room
objects.description: Somewhere in the house a thing can be: a room, a cupboard inside it, a shelf inside that.

indexes.name: name
indexes.description: Finds a room by what the household calls it, which is how anyone actually searches.

objects.name: belonging
objects.description: Something the household owns: one appliance with a serial number, or a count of something bought by the box.

indexes.name: category
indexes.description: The insurance inventory, grouped the way a claim form asks for it.

objects.name: relocation
objects.description: A record of something being moved, brought home, used up or given away.

indexes.name: occurred
indexes.description: "When did we last see it?", read newest first.

objects.name: reservation
objects.description: Something set aside for a known purpose — packed for a trip, promised to a neighbour — so nobody counts it as available.

indexes.name: due_back
indexes.description: What is set aside and past the day it was meant for, without going through the status the sweep reads.

objects.name: code_sequence
objects.description: The counters behind room and belonging codes.

objects.name: warranty
objects.description: A household's own record of what is still under warranty. The module knows nothing about this — it is declared here because a domain that needs a field of its own declares an object of its own.

fields.name: document
fields.description: Where the paperwork is, or a scan of it.

indexes.name: belonging
indexes.description: Finds the cover on one belonging.
